convention.level_frame: lidar_level: origin at the front lidar, Z against gravity, yaw of the front lidar. p_level = T_level_front * p_front = T_level_rear * p_rear
convention.rpy_deg: [roll, pitch, yaw] in degrees, R = Rz(yaw) * Ry(pitch) * Rx(roll)
convention.t_mm: translation in millimeters; the matrices are in meters

installation_seed.meaning: Rear lidar relative to the front lidar after each one is leveled with its own IMU: yaw 180 deg (mirrored heads) and the 247.5 mm baseline along -X. Roll and pitch are not part of the seed.

note: refine-auto reads this file as the seed and never overwrites it. ./calibrate.sh initial rewrites it.
